questions.q: In a not-for-profit making organization, the equivalent of a sole trader's capital is known as the
questions.explain: Not-for-profit organizations (like clubs, societies, and charities) do not have owners or shareholders, so they do not have a 'Capital Account'. Instead, the surplus of assets over liabilities is credited to an **Accumulated Fund**, which represents the net worth of the organization built up over the years.
